zitate.zitat: caches recent virtual-to-physical translations per page
zitate.absatz: Virtual memory systems translate addresses on every access. The translation lookaside buffer (TLB) caches recent virtual-to-physical translations per page. A TLB miss is handled by walking the page table; only if the page table entry is invalid does the hardware raise a page fault and invoke the operating system.
